description_en: The two-storey Patukvā Sataḥ can be dated to the early 17th century. Its five-bayedphalcāfaces south. Thekalasacolumns are remarkably delicate and are original to the building. Akalasais a ritual pot and was a typical carving motif at that time. The stairs at the rear lead up to a small private courtyard from where the first floor of thesataḥcan be accessed. Two empty niches in the back wall used to house statues of deities. The building was severely damaged as a result of the 2015 earthquakes and is braced with wooden beams in order to prevent its collapse. A photograph taken in February 2015 shows the column on the extreme left missing; since then the central column was stolen.In August 2023, following an order by the Mayor who cited the damagedsataḥas a safety hazard, the Lalitpur Municipal Police demolished thesataḥ.
description_ne: पतुक्व टोलको चोकमा शिखर शैलीमा बनेको हरिशंकर मन्दिर छ (LAL1150) । उक्त मन्दिरको पूर्वपट्टि यो सतः अवस्थित छ । पतुक्व चोकबाट पाटन दरबार क्षेत्रतिर लाग्दा बाटोको उत्तर दिशामा यो सतः बनेको छ । सतः बनेको मिति र निर्माताबारे जानकारी दिने कुनै अभिलेख प्राप्त छैन । भूमि तल्लामा बनेको फल्चाको भित्तामा दुईवटा खोपीहरु रहेका छन् जसमा विगतमा ढुङ्गाका मूर्तिहरु भएको र केही दशक पूर्व चोरी भएको भनाई स्थानीय बृद्धहरुको छ । सतःको माथिल्लो तल्लामा कपाली परिवार बस्दै आएका छन् । सतःमा हाल कुनै किसिमको धार्मिक एवं सांस्कृतिक गतिविधि हुनेगरेको पाइदैन । गत भूकम्पबाट क्षति भएको सतःलाई टेकाको भर दिइएको छ । जीर्ण सतः पुनःनिर्माणको निम्ति हालसम्म कुनै पक्षबाट पहल कद्मी भएको देखिदैन ।
monument_assessment: Demolition/Dismantling, Heavily damaged (collapsed, demolished, major cracks and structural damages)
